lead.title: Hermes Agent launches fully open-source, taking on paid agents
lead.summary: Nous Research released Hermes Agent, an open-source agent platform with persistent remote compute, any-model/provider support and Mixture of Agents blending. It responds directly to Grok Bot's remote-compute claims, positioning cloud instances at far lower cost, and highlights self-improving agents with no vendor lock-in.

top_stories.title: NVIDIA in $6B move to acquire or back a top-performing model factory
top_stories.summary: A roughly $6B deal to acquire or heavily invest in a model factory whose models outperform reference benchmarks, flagged by Latent Space as the emerging AI-native company landscape takes shape.

top_stories.title: Chinese humanoid makers admit the real obstacle: humans are still better
top_stories.summary: At the World Robot Conference, Unitree's founder said robots still struggle to generalize while its shares fell 18.7% after an IPO-day surge; Keenon said it has shipped over 100,000 robots and expects 150,000 by end of next year.

top_stories.title: Dots3-note: open-weight 280B MoE built for long-horizon autonomy
top_stories.summary: A 280B-total/16B-active MoE with 512K context and recursive self-critique, featuring a test-time agentic value model (TEMPO) and a perfect 42/42 in a math-proof harness at IMO 2026. Free preview on OpenRouter.

top_stories.title: Callosum raises $100M seed to route AI workloads across chips and models
top_stories.summary: One of Europe's largest seed rounds, led by Atomico with Plural, DCVC and the UK Sovereign AI Fund, for London-based AI inference orchestration.

items.title: SemaPLC: verification-gated PLC code generation
items.summary: A project-grounded, verification-gated agent harness that only declares tasks complete when external checks pass. Record 72.6% mean strict verified pass rate across seven models and a dynamic-behavior score of 52.2 vs 22.4-31.4 for baselines on live PLC runtime traces.

items.title: SPADE: self-play in adaptive synthetic executable environments
items.summary: One LLM writes executable Gym-style environments while another solves them. Scaling to 30B parameters improves over the strongest fixed-environment baseline by +5.3 on average across eight held-out benchmarks, and lifts tool-use by +5.7 on BFCL-v4 and +13.9 on ACEBench-Agent.

items.title: FM-Bench: long-horizon management with competing agents
items.summary: LLMs run a football club for 20 in-game years with ~340-400 decision stops and 26 tools; all 15 frontier models finish where scripted baselines die, and claude-fable-5 tops both solo and Arena tracks with the title rotating among ten models.

items.title: SkillGate: training in-policy skill selection for long-horizon agents
items.summary: Giving skill-naming tokens an action-local advantage in a 16-candidate slate lifts a 9B policy from 40.8% to 53.2% trial success across five agentic benchmarks, while cutting misleading skill exposure by two thirds.

items.title: Study: agents lock into post-training strategies early
items.summary: Examining a large set of public post-training trajectories, researchers find agents fix their initial training strategy early and then only adjust locally. Experience-driven scaffolds gave +12.6 on GSM8K and +40.8 on HumanEval, while extra inference compute did little to enable mid-execution shifts.

items.title: Yutori AI's Navigator web agent, built on post-trained Qwen models
items.summary: Together AI showcases Navigator, which reportedly achieves 2-5x better cost and speed than closed models on web tasks via ~80% prefix cache hit rates, speculative decoding, and heavy SFT+RL post-training of Qwen models.

items.title: Awesome Gemma repo centralizes model cards and fine-tuning recipes
items.summary: Philipp Schmid's GitHub hub covers 16 Gemma variants with setup guides for Ollama/vLLM/LiteRT, fine-tuning recipes via Unsloth, Tunix and MLX, plus community projects.

items.title: Karpathy muses on extrapolating LLM architecture down to 'microgpt' scale
items.summary: Very small, scalar-valued Python-with-loops model specs could anchor the extreme efficiency end of open-weights development, Karpathy argues — anything larger being a compilation problem. A design note, not a release.

items.title: Ox Alpha: free anonymous 'stealth' reasoning model on OpenRouter
items.summary: Released via an anonymous third-party provider, it offers a 1M-token context window, text/image/video input and tool calling, positioned for coding and long-horizon agentic work.

items.title: Binance now lets AI agents trade on its exchange
items.summary: Agent applications can trade directly via MCP and other developer tooling, though Binance warns that agent 'keep-safes' remain largely the trader's responsibility. Rival exchanges are moving similarly.

items.title: Codacy Skills let coding agents set up test coverage
items.summary: The third open-sourced entry in Codacy's Skills series lets agents discover code paths and auto-configure test coverage, keeping instrumentation and assertions in sync with agent-generated code.

items.title: Show HN: Molecule.dev — AI-first composable package ecosystem
items.summary: An open-source, AI-first composable package ecosystem launched on Show HN, aimed at letting agents compose and manage packages as modular building blocks.

items.title: Show HN: luoluoAI — gateway for OpenAI and Claude protocols
items.summary: An API gateway compatible with both the OpenAI and Anthropic Claude Messages formats, letting one endpoint serve tooling built for either protocol.
